Text_Reference: Evidence-layer structured paraphrase; not a verbatim quotation. Source release: https://github.com/404NotFound422/TOCAgentProject/tree/5e3a711befb3952a2e39f4d53fc9c9f1a7ac0d22/KnowledgeBase/evidence_expansion_20261019

General_Description.Text: activeDISCO enables large-scale exploration of human brain anatomy by light sheet microscopy. (2026). Evidence category: method. This card preserves the evidence layer's structured statements and their original field labels; it does not add a new literature review or certify benchmark scoring thresholds.
Text_Reference: Evidence-layer structured paraphrase; not a verbatim quotation. Source release: https://github.com/404NotFound422/TOCAgentProject/tree/5e3a711befb3952a2e39f4d53fc9c9f1a7ac0d22/KnowledgeBase/evidence_expansion_20261019

Application.Text1:
evidence_units:
id: A01
sample: human postmortem brain
label: none
stage: sample provenance
finding: Donors aged, without neurological disease history; individual age and sex not reported. Postmortem interval <24 h; fixed 4% PFA 5 d. No live-human treatment inference.
source_locator: Methods Par35; reporting summary p2
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text2:
evidence_units:
id: A02
sample: pig hemispheres; separate human 10 mm cortex
label: autofluorescence
stage: bleaching comparison
finding: Six pig groups n=3 show decolorization plateau at 10% H2O2; human 10 mm pigmentation continues improving to 30%. Different species endpoints must remain separate.
source_locator: Par12-14; Fig1A; SFig1-2
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text3:
evidence_units:
id: A03
sample: human 10 mm cortex
label: AF 638/690 and 488/525 nm
stage: signal outcome
finding: Higher bleaching can improve transmission/uniformity while reducing far-red AF signal. This does not demonstrate GFP retention or immunolabel compatibility.
source_locator: Fig1C-G; Par13-14; source workbook Figure1E/F/G
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text4:
evidence_units:
id: A04
sample: pig hemispheres, 18 across six groups
label: none
stage: morphology
finding: Reported reductions: pole distance 1.28-fold; thickness 1.25-fold; mass 2.04-fold; volume 2.12-fold. Different physical quantities, not interchangeable shrinkage percentages.
source_locator: Fig1B; workbook Figure1B
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text5:
evidence_units:
id: A05
sample: human cortex 5,10,20 mm n=3/group
label: none
stage: transmission comparison
finding: At 638 nm, activeDISCO significantly exceeds MASH at 5 mm, iDISCO and MASH at 10/20 mm. Pairwise activeDISCO versus SHANEL is NOT significant (p=.3225,.9965,.5028 respectively); avoid universal superiority statement.
source_locator: Par17; Fig2D; workbook Figure2D Tukey rows
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text6:
evidence_units:
id: A06
sample: human cortex 10 mm comparison
label: AF 638 excitation,690 long-pass
stage: imaging
finding: At ~1 mm all compared methods reveal structures; at4 and9 mm activeDISCO retains finer details. This depth result is not fluorescence mass-retention assay.
source_locator: Par16; Fig2C; SFig5
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text7:
evidence_units:
id: A07
sample: human cortex 20 mm
label: AF
stage: imaging
finding: 2x/4x macroscopic grey/white and vascular patterns;16x neuronal cell bodies/lipofuscin ROI. Whole specimen multiresolution imaging not uniform16x coverage.
source_locator: Par18; Fig3
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text8:
evidence_units:
id: A08
sample: intact human hippocampus
label: AF
stage: imaging
finding: 2x/4x hippocampal gross regions and CA fields;16x selected cellular layers.
source_locator: Par19; Fig4; SFig6
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

label: AF

finding: 2x major olivary/arcuate features;4x inferior olivary nucleus.

Application.Text10:
evidence_units:
id: A10
sample: human cerebellar hemisphere
label: AF638/690
stage: imaging
finding: Before ~55 cm3; after ~26 cm3, dimensions~41x38x44 mm. Two-angle2x acquisition; resolution/contrast worsens centrally beyond~14mm. Slice10mm4x and ROI16x are separate branches.
source_locator: Par21; Fig5F-N; SFig6
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text11:
evidence_units:
id: A11
sample: human5mm cerebellum and10mm cortex
label: AF at638/690,532/620,488/525
stage: spectral comparison
finding: Longer-wavelength branches maintain intensity to >4/>9 mm respectively;488nm attenuation severe beyond~3mm. Segmented vascular reconstruction includes intensity-drop correction; not true new labeling.
source_locator: Par22; Fig6; SFig7
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text16:

id: A16
sample: human fixed specimens
label: none
stage: RI matching
finding: DBE37C until maximum transparency; refresh after a few days if inadequate. No fixed universal RI duration.
source_locator: Par36

Application.Text17:
evidence_units:
id: A17
sample: human20mm cortex/intact brain regions
label: none
stage: whole clearing duration
finding: Approx12d reported overview in abstract/SuppTable1 and illustrated Fig2A; not add-immunolabeling total or universal fixed endpoint. Five-day fixation and days of acquisition must be distinct.
source_locator: Abstract; Fig2A; STable1; Discussion Par28
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: source_reported_observation_or_processing

Application.Text18:
evidence_units:
id: A18
sample: human tissue
label: immunolabel,FP,hybridization
stage: compatibility boundary
finding: Only AF demonstrated. Robust vascular/cell labeling still needed; cresyl violet on related pathoDISCO does not establish activeDISCO large-brain compatibility. HCR/antibody/other dye compatibility remains future work.
source_locator: Discussion Par26,32
evidence_type: author_discussion_not_compatibility_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: unvalidated_compatibility_boundary_and_author_future_work
compatibility_positive_assertion_eligible: false

Application.Text19:
evidence_units:
id: A19
sample: 200nm beads in gelatin
label: fluorescent beads
stage: instrument calibration
finding: Measured lateral/axial resolution20xNA.45=.9/3.8um;40xNA.8=.6/2.9um. This is calibration, not observed resolution in entire thick human brain.
source_locator: SFig8; Methods optical characterization
evidence_type: primary_experiment
review_status: independently_source_checked_with_stated_scope
assertion_role: instrument_calibration_not_tissue_performance
